headlines.description: — Brandon Miller scored 17 points, and the Charlotte Hornets routed the Dallas Mavericks 117-90 on Tuesday night for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hornets rout Mavericks 117-90 for 5th straight victory and .500 record

headlines.description: — Jaylon Tyson scored 22 points, James Harden added 18 and the Cleveland Cavaliers avenged a recent loss in Detroit by beating the East-leading Pistons 113-109 on Tuesday night despite playing without injured star Donovan Mitchell.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Tyson, James Harden lead Cavs past Pistons 113-109 without injured star Donovan Mitchell

headlines.description: — Paolo Banchero equaled a season high with 37 points, Desmond Bane scored 25 and the Orlando Magic eased to a 126-109 victory over the Washington Wizards on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Paolo Banchero matches season high with 37 points as Magic ease past Wizards 126-109

headlines.description: — Bam Adebayo had 23 points, nine rebounds and six steals, and the Miami Heat beat the Brooklyn Nets 124-98 on Tuesday night in the opener of a two-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adebayo and Herro lead Heat to 124-98 victory over Nets in the opener of a two-game series

events.name: New York Knicks at Toronto Raptors

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson had 26 points and 10 assists, Karl-Anthony Towns added 21 points and 12 rebounds, and the New York Knicks beat the Toronto Raptors 111-95 on Wednesday night for their fifth win in six games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores 26 as Knicks beat Raptors 111-95, extending win streak over Toronto to 12

headlines.description: — Dylan Harper scored 22 points and Victor Wembanyama needed only 10 to help the San Antonio Spurs bounce back from their first loss in 12 games and rout the Philadelphia 76ers 131-91 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Harper scores 22, Spurs rebound from 1st loss in 12 games to romp past 76ers 131-91

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Chicago Bulls

headlines.description: — Jared McCain scored 20 points, Isaiah Joe added 19 and the Oklahoma City Thunder — playing without star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander — beat the Chicago Bulls 116-108 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCain scores 20 as Thunder beat Bulls 116-108 without Gilgeous-Alexander

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 41 points as the Minnesota Timberwolves overcame a sluggish first half to beat the Memphis Grizzlies 117-110 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Edwards scores 41 as Timberwolves beat Grizzlies 117-110 for 4th straight win

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 27 points, 10 rebounds and seven assists, LeBron James added 21 points and the Los Angeles Lakers rallied past the New Orleans Pelicans 110-101 Tuesday night for their third...
headlines.shortLinkText: Luka Doncic scores 27 points as the Lakers rally past the Pelicans, 110-101

headlines.description: — Jalen Green scored 20 points, Grayson Allen had 18 and the Phoenix Suns beat the NBA-worst Sacramento Kings 114-103 on Tuesday night to sweep the four-game season series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suns beat the NBA-worst Kings 114-103 to sweep season series
